items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: when we went to Chicago with Trummy, that the tenor saxophone player was a guy whose name was Leo Williams.

ctx.x: So it just happened that these two guys was George Treadwell, the trumpet player that was formerly married to Sarah Vaughan, and Bud Powell was the kid's name. And I didn't see Bud again until after I got to New York, which I'll talk about later, and we really became friends. But Bud must have been about 16 years old then -- he was very young, as I was saying. The band that he was with... It keeps coming to mind that he was with Tiny Bradshaw's band. But when I got to New York a year or so later, he was with…

Anyway, I don't remember whether I mentioned the fact that when we went to Chicago with Trummy, that the tenor saxophone player was a guy whose name was Leo Williams. I don't know whether I mentioned his name. I know I mentioned Tommy Potter and Harry Curtis, the alto saxophone player, Trummy, of course, and Eddie Bert. I don't know if I did mention him or not, but Leo Williams was one of those
